goal: 请通过 CLI 点亮红灯
summary: Split the task into smaller stage-aligned subtasks so a local model can finish one focused step at a time.

subtasks.title: Confirm the exact existing CLI command.
subtasks.objective: Map the natural-language goal to a built-in UART CLI command without inventing code work.
subtasks.done_when: The exact UART command is fixed for this run.

subtasks.title: Lock the verify-only path.
subtasks.objective: Confirm that no code edits are required and the next round should jump directly to verification.
subtasks.done_when: The task is confirmed as verify-only.

subtasks.title: Run the UART CLI command.
subtasks.objective: Execute the exact UART command and capture transcript evidence.
subtasks.done_when: A fresh transcript shows the command response.

subtasks.title: Report from transcript evidence only.
subtasks.objective: Use the transcript and diagnostics to report pass, fail, blocked, or needs_review.
subtasks.done_when: The result is supported by fresh UART evidence.
